purpose: Read-mode editorial storyboard; original diagrams specified, not rendered assets.

modeContract.switchBehavior: Preserve shared lesson, practice answers, progress and preferences. Switching mode never resets or completes a lesson. Map Watch chapter cues to Read panel IDs; when no precise cue exists, switch at the same lesson and announce that position.
modeContract.fullText: Always expose Full lesson text as semantic HTML, including every original content paragraph, activity, knowledge check and referenced source. Never hide the only accessible equivalent behind animation.
modeContract.practice: Use the identical source activity and knowledgeCheck in both modes. Do not duplicate scoring or alter answer IDs.
modeContract.watchUnavailable: Keep Read accessible. Label Watch unavailable or preparing honestly; never display a fake playable asset.

deliveryNote: Compact derivative. Read original course JSON for verbatim content, activities, checks, source links and assessment keys. All diagrams are specified-not-rendered native HTML/CSS or accessible SVG. No production artwork is claimed. Canonical design artifact is read-storyboards.json.

panelDefaults.interaction: Explicit Next/Back and optional native details; no auto-advance. Keep callouts visible; full source text remains available.
panelDefaults.visualAssetType: original semantic diagram or native case card
panelDefaults.textEquivalent: Use panel copy plus mapped source paragraphs; use original numerical tables where specified.

panels.title: Match the whole review target
copy: Avery Chen; NS-204; 5–9 October 2026.
Check worker, assignment, period, status and authority.
panels.visualSpecification: Synthetic request card with five labeled evidence fields; do not imitate Fieldglass UI.

copy: Submitted sheets may appear through Work Items or the Time Sheet list.
Actions depend on role and configuration.

copy: TS-104 matches NS-204.
TS-099 is the same person and week, but NS-188.
Confirm authority before acting.

lessons.title: Reconcile daily detail, not only totals

panels.title: Use the supplied review policy
copy: Bill verified worked hours.
DEL means delivery; TRN means training.
Overtime needs specified approval evidence.
panels.visualSpecification: Three labeled policy cards above the synthetic evidence ledger.
panels.callout: Fictional training policy, not an SAP rule or employment-law instruction.

panels.title: Compare the daily lines
copy: Wednesday: 6 DEL + 2 TRN, not 8 DEL.
Friday: 6 DEL, not 8.
Verified total: 36 DEL + 2 TRN = 38.
panels.visualSpecification: Accessible five-day evidence-versus-submission table with changed cells tagged Coding mismatch and Hours mismatch.
panels.callout: A correct weekly total can still conceal a coding error.

panels.title: Clarify conflicting evidence
copy: Pause when source records disagree.
Ask the responsible person.
Record only needed facts.
panels.visualSpecification: Evidence conflict card linked to a clarification route rather than an assumed numeric fix.
panels.callout: A discrepancy is not proof of intent. Do not silently edit another person’s time.

lessons.title: Choose the action and explain the correction

panels.title: Choose the evidence-based route
copy: Accurate and eligible: approve.
Editable submitted sheet needing correction: reject under local process.
Unclear evidence or authority: escalate.
panels.visualSpecification: Three-branch decision diagram with conditions on arrows.
panels.callout: Available routes and reason categories are configured locally.

panels.title: Make the correction actionable
copy: Name the period and affected dates.
State verified values and supporting records.
Ask for correction and resubmission.
panels.visualSpecification: Annotated original TS-104 reason with evidence and next action adjacent to the relevant sentence.
panels.callout: Confirm TS-104 before rejecting; avoid vague criticism or unsupported allegations.

Thursday: 8 DEL should be 6 DEL + 2 TRN.
panels.visualSpecification: New-case packet and two-to-three-sentence scaffold; full rubric revealed after attempt.

TS-088 Friday DEL: 8 recorded, 6 supported.
